assumptions: per-flip |dr| bounded by 2*(cost + an adverse move of the same size) = 0.012 — generous, since a flipped decision is BY CONSTRUCTION at the threshold and therefore near break-even
sigma_r = 0.004 per-period net return dispersion (order of the money-leg series)
mean_r = 0.0002 for the dispersion-correction term only
flips distributed independently across periods; a clustered adversarial arrangement would raise the dispersion term but not the leading mean term
REAL grid 35,064 periods x 40 symbols per (cell,seed), 5 cells x 5 seeds
